learning: Public NL/EN switching must be owned by the canonical site-shell build and deterministic locale routes, not by ad-hoc page scripts or runtime translation.
invariant: Header, footer, mega-menu, navigation and language switching inherit one shared shell; public locale switching preserves the current route and navigates to prebuilt /en equivalents.
prevention: Keep public language controls as real links with hreflang.
Bind same-page locale hrefs during localized build.
Reserve runtime translation for portal and dynamic contexts.
